title: Completion of First Work Project
content: I was tasked me to keep track on the IT inventory and create a database for it. Although it took me a while I can finally say I have completed my first work project.

title: 5K Foam Fest Run
content: Today I decided to participate in the 5K foam fest run. It was a 5k run through foam and many obstacles. As challenging and tiring as it may have been, I thoroughly enjoyed the experience and can't wait for next year (I also got a nice finishers medal).

title: Summer Internship Secured!
summary: After months of applying I finally found a job in IT.
content: Today was my first day at  my summer internship with Circle of Care. Summer tech internships are one of the hardest things to land. I was able to do it not because I'm special but because I believed. Really excited about this opportunity!!
